title: Application Letter and CV
ringkas: Menulis surat lamaran dan riwayat hidup
goals: memahami tujuan dan bagian-bagian **application letter** (surat lamaran kerja)
memahami isi **CV / resume**: data pribadi, pendidikan, pengalaman, keterampilan, dan referensi
memakai ungkapan formal: [[I am writing to apply for ...]], [[I would like to apply for ...]], [[I look forward to ...]]
menyebutkan kualifikasi, pengalaman, dan keterampilan dengan kalimat yang meyakinkan
memakai **simple present**, **simple past**, dan **present perfect** dalam surat lamaran
menulis surat lamaran dan CV sederhana

lesson.text: Suatu hari kamu akan melamar magang atau pekerjaan. Perusahaan biasanya meminta dua dokumen: **application letter** (surat lamaran) dan **CV** (riwayat hidup). Surat lamaran yang baik **sopan, singkat, dan meyakinkan**. Di unit ini kamu belajar membaca dan menulis keduanya.

lesson.title: 1. Bagian application letter
table: [[The Human Resources Manager, PT Maju Jaya]]
[[I am writing to apply for the position of Office Assistant.]]
[[I look forward to hearing from you.]]

lesson.title: Salam dan penutup harus serasi
lesson.text: Jika tidak tahu nama penerima: [[Dear Sir or Madam,]] → [[Yours faithfully,]]. Jika tahu nama: [[Dear Mr. Adi,]] → [[Yours sincerely,]].

lesson.title: 2. Bagian CV
table: nama, alamat, telepon, email, tanggal lahir
pekerjaan atau magang, dari yang terbaru
orang yang bisa dihubungi untuk rekomendasi

lesson.title: 4. Ungkapan formal
table: [[I am writing to apply for the position of ... advertised in ...]]
[[I would like to apply for the position of ...]]
[[I graduated from ... in ...]] / [[I hold a ... diploma.]]
[[I have worked as ... for ... years.]] / [[I did an internship at ...]]
[[I am able to ...]] / [[I am skilled in ...]] / [[I am fluent in ...]]
[[I enclose my CV.]] / [[Please find my CV attached.]]
[[I look forward to hearing from you.]] / [[Thank you for your time and consideration.]]
[[I am available for an interview at any time.]]

lesson.title: 5. Tense yang dipakai
table: pendidikan dan pengalaman yang sudah selesai
[[I graduated in 2025.]] / [[I worked as a cashier.]]
[[I have worked as a tutor for two years.]]
[[I would be grateful for the opportunity.]]

lesson.title: Gunakan bahasa formal
lesson.text: Hindari singkatan seperti [[I'm]], [[I'd]], dan kata santai seperti [[hi]], [[thanks]]. Tulis [[I am]], [[I would]], [[Dear ...]], [[Thank you]]. Tulis juga hanya **fakta yang benar** tentang dirimu.

lines.id: Saya lampirkan CV saya untuk pertimbangan Anda. Saya bersedia diwawancarai kapan saja. Saya menantikan kabar dari Anda.

lines.en: Mr. Adi, I want to apply for a part-time job at a bookshop. What should I include in my letter?
lines.id: Pak Adi, saya ingin melamar kerja paruh waktu di toko buku. Apa yang harus saya tulis di surat?

lines.en: First, say which position you are applying for. Then write your education, experience, and skills.
lines.id: Pertama, sebutkan posisi yang kamu lamar. Lalu tulis pendidikan, pengalaman, dan keterampilanmu.

lines.en: Yes. Also, use formal language and check your spelling.
lines.id: Ya. Juga, pakai bahasa formal dan periksa ejaanmu.

read.text:
Jl. Melati No. 5, Bandung. 10 March 2025. Human Resources Manager, PT Cahaya Maju. Dear Sir or Madam,
I am writing to apply for the position of Graphic Designer advertised on your website on 5 March. I graduated from Bandung Institute of Design in 2024 with a Bachelor's degree in Visual Communication. During my internship at a local studio, I designed posters and social media content for ten clients.
I am creative, responsible, and able to work under pressure. I have enclosed my CV and portfolio. I would be grateful for an opportunity to be interviewed. Thank you for your consideration. Yours faithfully, Dewi Lestari

read.id:
Dewi sedang menulis CV pertamanya. Dia sudah belajar desain grafis selama tiga tahun, dan dia bekerja sebagai desainer lepas sejak 2022. Tahun lalu, dia mendesain logo untuk toko roti lokal, dan pemiliknya sangat puas.
Dalam CV-nya, dia mencantumkan keterampilan dan pencapaiannya. Dia juga menulis bahwa dia akan dapat bekerja dengan jam fleksibel. Dia bertanya pada gurunya, "Maukah Bapak menjadi referensi saya?" Dia menjawab, "Tentu. Saya akan menulis rekomendasi yang kuat untukmu."

read.text:
Dewi is writing her first CV. She has been learning graphic design for three years, and she has been working as a freelance designer since 2022. Last year, she designed a logo for a local bakery, and the owner was very pleased.
In her CV, she lists her skills and her achievements. She also writes that she will be able to work flexible hours. She asks her teacher, "Would you be my reference?" He answers, "Of course. I will write a strong recommendation for you."

Interviewer: Why do you want this job, Ms. Wulan? Wulan: I have been working as an assistant for three years, and I would like to take more responsibility. I have been learning accounting in the evenings.
Interviewer: Will you be able to start next month? Wulan: Yes, I will. I'll be able to finish my current project by then. Interviewer: And where do you see yourself in five years? Wulan: I would like to be a finance manager.
